project: Smells Like Team Spirit: Startups as a Band
notes: Graffiti hero A, the all-three red-circled classifieds page, the ELEVEN Perfect Co-Founder ad, and the Influences card are used in the post. Graffiti B/C, the shapes slides, the focused circles, the PWV ad, the single ad, the bullet-run Influences card, and Poster A/B are alternates.

artwork.prompt: Wide 16:9 black-and-white documentary photograph of a weathered, peeling exterior wall, shot straight on, like the famous 'Kurt smells like teen spirit' graffiti wall. Rough hand-painted black graffiti in uneven capital letters across the center: 'SMELLS LIKE' on the first line, 'TEAM SPIRIT' on the second, and a smaller scrawl below: 'STARTUPS AS A BAND'. A small dark plaque on the right edge reads '11'. Grimy concrete, chipped paint, stains, cracked plaster, harsh daylight. Grainy black-and-white film, high contrast, documentary photography. Render all quoted text exactly, correctly spelled and legible, hand-painted and slightly uneven. No real logos, no signatures.
